desc: Implement and validate Boolean transformation composition and binary exponentiation for long good segments.
Specify exact state initialization and position conventions, including square 1 and whether N is bad.
Process sorted disjoint bad intervals, truncating each bad stretch to at most B steps and terminating when the reachable state becomes zero.
Prove correctness and ensure complexity is O(M B^2 log N).
Produce the final Python stdin/stdout solution with exact `Yes`/`No` output.
